# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Only the latest published release of super-backlog receives security fixes.

| Version | Supported |
| ------- | --------- |
| Latest release | Yes |
| Older releases | No |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Report vulnerabilities through [GitHub private advisories](https://github.com/adam-s-k-i/super-backlog/security/advisories/new).

Do not open a public issue, pull request, or discussion for a security report.

Include:

- A description of the issue
- Steps to reproduce
- Affected versions, if you know them
- Impact, if you know it

The maintainer will acknowledge the report within 7 days and follow up with a fix plan or a decision not to treat it as a vulnerability.
